sqlmap.query: /* sqlmap.xml.selectIncompleteWorkPermitList */ SELECT CONCAT(PERMIT_NO_1, PERMIT_NO_2) AS SHE_PERMIT_NO, WORK_PERMIT_TYPE, RTRIM( CASE WHEN CLOSED_SPACE = 'true' THEN '밀폐공간, ' END || CASE WHEN BLACKOUT = 'true' THEN '정전, ' END || CASE WHEN EXCAVATION = 'true' THEN '굴착, ' END || CASE WHEN RADIATION = 'true' THEN '방사선, ' END || CASE WHEN HEIGHT = 'true' THEN '고소, ' END || CASE WHEN HEAVY_EQUIPMENT = 'true' THEN '중장비' END, ', ' ) AS SHE_SUP_WORK, WORK_SUMMARY, WORK_PERMIT_YMD, PERMIT_DT, 'N' AS WORK_FINISH_WORKER_YN FROM SHED.SAF_WORK_PERMIT WHERE REGEXP_SUBSTR(PERMIT_NO_1, '[^-]+', 1, 1) = '순창' AND WORK_FINISH_WORKER_SIGN IS NULL

/* sqlmap.xml.selectSafetyInspectionList */ SELECT UUID, MACHINE_NAME, INSTALL_PLACE, MODEL_NO, KCS, SPEC_FLUID, SPEC_CAPACITY, SPEC_DESIGN_PRESSURE, SPEC_OPERATING_PRESSURE, MANUFACTURER, USAGE, VALIDITY_FROM, VALIDITY_TO, NOTE FROM dbo.SAF_INSPECTION_LIST WHERE WORKPLACE = '순창'
